drifts.mixerBehavior: renderChoicesHTML does not read q.choiceColumns and uses compact/block/boxed detection.
drifts.clinicBehavior: renderChoicesHTML chooses compact/block/boxed and has no choiceColumns branch.
drifts.rationale: Question Authority owns choiceColumns semantics; Mixer and Clinic adapters yield no requested columns until a source explicitly carries that field.

drifts.archiveBehavior: Archive index output UI offers 4 and 6 QPP.
drifts.mixerBehavior: Mixer upstream offers 2/4/6/8, while mixed_engine normalizes only 4/6/8.
drifts.rationale: 2-QPP is a capability discrepancy, not a RenderAuthority migration side effect. Current production engine behavior remains unchanged.

drifts.archiveBehavior: Archive has exam, solution, and answer render paths only.
drifts.mixerBehavior: Mixer has exam, solution, answer, and PDF viewer paths; it has no review renderer mode.
drifts.clinicBehavior: Clinic dispatches state.mode === review to renderStudentReviewPacket.
drifts.rationale: Review is a PrintJob composition of answer then solution sections, not a fourth pure question renderer mode.

drifts.archiveBehavior: preview=1 continues to render the URL data= baseline.
drifts.mixerBehavior: Mixed output is URL/storage or pack sourced; no parent preview protocol exists.
drifts.clinicBehavior: preview=1 installs AP_CLINIC_PREVIEW but boot first loads URL/storage payload.
drifts.rationale: Phase 2.5 uses AP_PRINT_READY/AP_PRINT_PREVIEW with legacy aliases; preview renders only a placeholder before parent authority arrives.

drifts.archiveBehavior: Browser/vector, raster, native, and GDI print paths are exposed.
drifts.mixerBehavior: Browser/vector, raster, native, and GDI print paths are exposed.
drifts.rationale: Readiness becomes common authority; adapter transport capabilities stay engine-specific.

drifts.archiveBehavior: Archive uses a URL script source with a short-lived launch fallback.
drifts.mixerBehavior: Mixed output reads storage snapshots and falls back to packId assessment data.
drifts.clinicBehavior: Clinic accepts server packet/set, wp, storage, and parent payload candidates.
drifts.rationale: Renderer canonicalization must not change persistence or introduce server storage for Mixer.

drifts.archiveBehavior: Popup header options control title, metaRight, subtitle, name, score, and solution/answer application.
drifts.mixerBehavior: Uses Archive-style title/metaRight/subtitle header options, including unit-past snapshot metadata.
drifts.clinicBehavior: Has inline iframe header editing and recipient/date-oriented header options.
drifts.rationale: HeaderPolicy is canonical and preserves metaRight; each adapter retains its current editing shell and fields beyond the shared policy.

drifts.clinicBehavior: Reads answer, correctAnswer, correct, then ans.
drifts.rationale: Clinic alias resolution belongs to its normalizer; CanonicalQuestion presents one answer field.

drifts.archiveBehavior: Solution rendering accepts solution/explanation/sol at call sites.
drifts.mixerBehavior: Solution rendering accepts solution/explanation/sol at call sites.
drifts.clinicBehavior: Reads solution, explanation, commentary, then sol.
drifts.rationale: Clinic alias resolution belongs to its normalizer; CanonicalQuestion presents one solution field.

drifts.archiveBehavior: Renders q.image directly with Archive cache busting.
drifts.mixerBehavior: Renders q.image directly with Archive cache busting.
drifts.clinicBehavior: Accepts multiple raw image aliases and resolves against restored archive provenance.
drifts.rationale: RenderAuthority receives adapter-owned resolveAssetUrl(assetRef, question, sourceRef); it does not calculate source paths.

drifts.archiveBehavior: Uses q.solutionImage with size, alt, and caption fields.
drifts.mixerBehavior: Uses q.solutionImage with size, alt, and caption fields.
drifts.clinicBehavior: Resolves q.solutionImage against the restored archive source.
drifts.rationale: Solution-image semantic markup becomes common while URL provenance remains adapter-owned.

drifts.archiveBehavior: Waits with a fail-open timeout and exposes __AP_RENDER_READY__.
drifts.mixerBehavior: Waits with a fail-open timeout and exposes __AP_RENDER_READY__.
drifts.clinicBehavior: Waits with a fail-open timeout but has no shared render-ready promise.
drifts.rationale: Phase 6 records evidence for DATA_READY through PRINT_READY independently of adapter transport.

drifts.archiveBehavior: Owns staging and measured page/column placement in engine.html.
drifts.mixerBehavior: Owns staging and measured page/column placement in mixed_engine.html.
drifts.clinicBehavior: Owns recipient-aware measured page placement in wrong_print_engine.html.
drifts.rationale: Phase 2 extracts a source-agnostic LayoutAuthority producing PageMap, ColumnMap, continuation, and overflow evidence.

drifts.archiveBehavior: Splits long solution boxes across columns/pages.
drifts.mixerBehavior: Splits long solution boxes across columns/pages.
drifts.clinicBehavior: Contains a Clinic-specific port of split solution boxes.
drifts.rationale: Continuation identity and solutionImage single-placement become PageMap assertions before legacy code removal.

drifts.archiveBehavior: No recipient packet duplex boundary behavior.
drifts.mixerBehavior: No recipient packet duplex boundary behavior.
drifts.clinicBehavior: Inserts a physical blank page when the next recipient must start on a front side.
drifts.rationale: DuplexPolicy is canonical; only Clinic adapters enable recipient-boundary blanks where current behavior requires it.

drifts.archiveBehavior: Invalid URL source stops rendering with an archive load-error display.
drifts.mixerBehavior: Missing or invalid snapshot displays an input error or uses pack fallback.
drifts.clinicBehavior: Failed source restoration logs a warning and renders a visible load-failure box.
drifts.rationale: SOURCE_RESTORE_FAILED carries evidence and warning UI; silent payload substitution is prohibited.

drifts.archiveBehavior: Normalizes standalone view blocks only at a string or explicit line boundary.
drifts.clinicBehavior: Formats restored content without the Archive/Mixer normalizeViewBlocks helper.
drifts.rationale: Question Authority owns semantic view-label treatment and retains plain inline 보기 words.

drifts.archiveBehavior: Enriches each loaded question with source archive file and ordinal metadata.
drifts.mixerBehavior: Resolves source file, UID, ordinal, and legacy source number through question identity data.
drifts.rationale: SourceRef requires archive locator, UID, ordinal, and source number; displayNo and bare id never choose the source.

drifts.archiveBehavior: Reads submitQr and solQr independently, then calls injectQrToLastExamPage and injectSubmitQrToLastExamPage separately.
drifts.mixerBehavior: Reads submitQr and solQr independently, then calls the two QR injection paths separately.
drifts.clinicBehavior: Uses recipient-specific solution QR behavior rather than Archive/Mixer's two independent exam channels.
drifts.rationale: PrintSection preserves qrPolicies[] so submit and solution QR channels coexist without enum information loss; Clinic adapter maps its recipient channel independently.
